type.mono: DM Mono 400-500, for labels, values and code
type.files: fonts/ woff2 for pages (SIL OFL; licences alongside); fonts/ttf/ static Latin-1 TTFs for matplotlib, Pillow and office tools
type.figures: DM Sans 500 with tabular numerals for large figures (Syne's 0 reads as O); DM Mono for values in tables and charts

chart.note: Series are colours of the kit, each with an ink outline on the sheet. One measure is one colour: colour by series, never by category. The sheet has four series, the graphite field three (a fourth would fall under 3:1 on graphite). Rust is never a series: it marks a limit, threshold or over-limit value only. Values and ticks in DM Mono, gridlines hair. Use oa_chart.py for matplotlib.
